scope: Standing Maastricht basilica exterior, including the Romanesque westwork, Gothic southern chapels and Bergportaal, apsidal choir, and attached cloister and treasury ranges.
geometryBasis: Native BAG-backed basilica multipolygon including original courtyard void, coordinated with the measured church plan and Dutch heritage survey.
sectionBasis: Primary 1930s measured westwork heights and the exact 2023 south portal image control the west towers; other roof heights and site grades are approximate.
limitations: Model represents standing exterior and open cloister courtyard. It excludes the adjacent Sint-Janskerk.
Westwork heights follow the recorded measurements and photo silhouette. The apse, small towers, cloister, details, facade finishes and vertical terrain contact are approximate.
Crypt, treasury interiors and relief carvings are outside the exterior scope.
